<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">NOTES TO CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL STATEMENTS </span></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(Unaudited) </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</p><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000291" name="us-gaap:OrganizationConsolidationAndPresentationOfFinancialStatementsDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0000087347_20220101_20220331" escape="true">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">1.&#160;&#160; <span style="text-decoration:underline;">Basis of Presentation</span> </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The accompanying unaudited consolidated financial statements of Schlumberger Limited and its subsidiaries (&#8220;Schlumberger&#8221;) have been prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America for interim financial information and with the instructions to Form 10-Q and Article 10 of Regulation S-X.&#160;&#160;Accordingly, they do not include all of the information and footnotes required by generally accepted accounting principles for complete financial statements.&#160;&#160;In the opinion of Schlumberger management, all adjustments considered necessary for a fair statement have been included in the accompanying unaudited financial statements.&#160;&#160;All intercompany transactions and balances have been eliminated in consolidation.&#160;&#160;Operating results for the three-month period ended March 31, 2022 are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for the full year ending December&#160;31, 2022.&#160;&#160;The December&#160;31, 2021 balance sheet information has been derived from the Schlumberger 2021 audited financial statements.&#160;&#160;For further information, refer to the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Financial Statements</span> and notes thereto included in the Schlumberger Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December&#160;31, 2021, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on January&#160;26, 2022. </p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000292" name="us-gaap:RestructuringAndRelatedActivitiesDisclosureTextBlock" contextRef="C_0000087347_20220101_20220331" escape="true">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">2.&#160;&#160; <span style="text-decoration:underline;">Charges and Credits</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On December&#160;31, 2020, Schlumberger contributed its onshore hydraulic fracturing business in the United States and Canada, including its pressure pumping, pumpdown perforating and Permian frac sand business to Liberty Energy Inc. (&#8220;Liberty&#8221;) in exchange for an equity interest in Liberty.&#160;During the first quarter of 2022, Schlumberger sold <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlishares" id="F_000311" name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockNumberOfSharesIssuedInTransaction" contextRef="C_0000087347_srtScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis_slbLibertyEnergyIncMember_20220101_20220331" decimals="-5" scale="6">7.2</ix:nonFraction>&#160;million of its shares of Liberty and received proceeds of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000312" name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfCommonStock" contextRef="C_0000087347_srtScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis_slbLibertyEnergyIncMember_20220101_20220331" decimals="-6" scale="6">84</ix:nonFraction> million.&#160;&#160;As a result of this transaction Schlumberger recognized a gain of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000313" name="us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness" contextRef="C_0000087347_srtScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis_slbLibertyEnergyIncMember_20220101_20220331" decimals="-6" scale="6">26</ix:nonFraction> million.&#160;This gain is classified in <span style="font-style:italic;">Interest&#160;&#38; other income</span> in the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Statement of Income</span>.&#160;&#160;As of March 31, 2022, Schlumberger had a <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_xbrlipure" id="F_000314" name="us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOwnershipPercentage" contextRef="C_0000087347_srtScheduleOfEquityMethodInvestmentEquityMethodInvesteeNameAxis_slbLibertyEnergyIncMember_20220331" decimals="2" scale="-2">27</ix:nonFraction>% equity interest in Liberty.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger did not record any charges or credits during the first quarter of 2021.</p></ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric id="F_000293" name="us-gaap:EarningsPerShareTextBlock" contextRef="C_0000087347_20220101_20220331" escape="true">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">8.&#160;&#160; <span style="text-decoration:underline;">Derivative Instruments and Hedging Activities</span> </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As a multinational company, Schlumberger conducts its business in over <ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_slbCountry" id="F_000508" name="us-gaap:NumberOfCountriesInWhichEntityOperates" contextRef="C_0000087347_20220331" decimals="INF">120</ix:nonFraction> countries.&#160;&#160;Schlumberger&#8217;s functional currency is primarily the US dollar.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger is exposed to risks on future cash flows to the extent that the local currency is not the functional currency and expenses denominated in local currency are not equal to revenues denominated in local currency.&#160;&#160;Schlumberger uses foreign currency forward contracts to provide a hedge against a portion of these cash flow risks.&#160; These contracts are accounted for as cash flow hedges, with the changes in the fair value of the hedge recorded on the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Balance Sheet </span>and in <span style="font-style:italic;">Accumulated Other Comprehensive Loss.&#160; </span>Amounts recorded in<span style="font-style:italic;"> Accumulated Other Comprehensive Loss </span>are reclassified into earnings in the same period or periods that the hedged item is recognized in earnings.&#160; </p>
</ix:nonNumeric><p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">10</p>

Amounts recorded in <span style="font-style:italic;">Accumulated Other Comprehensive Loss</span> are reclassified to earnings in the same period or periods that the hedged item is recognized in earnings. Included in <span style="font-style:italic;">Accounts payable and accrued liabilities</span> was $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000547" name="us-gaap:GainLossOnOilAndGasHedgingActivity" contextRef="C_0000087347_20220101_20220331" decimals="-6" scale="6">94</ix:nonFraction> million at March 31, 2022 relating to the fair value of the outstanding commodity hedges. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger is exposed to changes in the fair value of assets and liabilities denominated in currencies other than the functional currency.&#160;&#160;While Schlumberger uses foreign currency forward contracts to economically hedge this exposure as it relates to certain currencies, these contracts are not designated as hedges for accounting purposes.&#160;&#160;Instead, the fair value of the contracts is recorded on the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Balance Sheet </span>and changes in the fair value are recognized in the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Statement of Income, </span>as are changes in the fair value of the hedged item.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">At March 31, 2022, contracts were outstanding for the US dollar equivalent of $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000548" name="us-gaap:DerivativeNotionalAmount" contextRef="C_0000087347_us-gaapDerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis_us-gaapForeignExchangeContractMember_20220331" decimals="INF" scale="9">7.6</ix:nonFraction> billion in various foreign currencies, of which $<ix:nonFraction unitRef="U_iso4217USD" id="F_000549" name="us-gaap:DerivativeNotionalAmount" contextRef="C_0000087347_us-gaapDerivativeInstrumentRiskAxis_us-gaapForeignExchangeContractMember_us-gaapFinancialInstrumentAxis_us-gaapDebtMember_us-gaapHedgingDesignationAxis_us-gaapDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentMember_20220331" decimals="INF" scale="9">5.8</ix:nonFraction> billion relates to hedges of debt denominated in currencies other than the functional currency. </p>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">13</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="ITEM_2_MANAGEMENTS_DISCUSSION_ANALYSIS_F"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;2.</span>&#160;&#160;<span style="text-decoration:underline;">Management&#8217;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.</span> </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The conflict in Ukraine that began in late February 2022 continues as of the date of this quarterly report. Schlumberger is deeply focused on the safety and security of its employees and their families in Ukraine, Russia and throughout the affected region.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger&#8217;s executive leadership established local and global crisis management teams which began meeting regularly in February 2022 to respond to the crisis and its effect on Schlumberger&#8217;s employees, business and operations, including impacts related to increased economic sanctions and export controls. In March 2022, Schlumberger decided to immediately suspend new investment and technology deployment to its Russia operations.&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Russia represented approximately 5% of Schlumberger&#8217;s worldwide revenue during the first quarter of 2022. The carrying value of Schlumberger&#8217;s net assets in Russia was approximately $0.8 billion as of March 31, 2022. This consisted of $0.2 billion of receivables, $0.2 billion of inventories, $0.3 billion of other current assets, $0.3 billion of fixed assets, $0.1 billion of other non-current assets and $0.3 billion of current liabilities. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger continues to actively monitor this dynamic situation and comply with applicable international laws and sanctions. The extent to which Schlumberger&#8217;s operations and financial results (including the need to potentially write-down the carrying value of certain assets) may be affected by the ongoing conflict in Ukraine will depend on various factors, including the extent and duration of the conflict&#59; the effects of the conflict on regional and global economic and geopolitical conditions&#59; the effect of further international sanctions and trade control restrictions on Schlumberger&#8217;s business, the global economy and global supply chains&#59; and the impact of further devaluation of the ruble. Continuation or escalation of the conflict may also aggravate the risk factors that Schlumberger identified in its Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2021.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">First Quarter 2022 Compared to Fourth Quarter 2021</span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">(3)</sup></span></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;">Interest expense excludes amounts which are included in the segments&#8217; income ($3 million in Q1 2022&#59; $4 million in Q4 2021).</p></td></tr></table></div>
<div style="align:left;">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0" style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">
<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:3.33%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">(4)</sup></span></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top"></sup>Charges and credits are described in detail in Note 2 to the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Financial Statements</span>.</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">First-quarter 2022 revenue of $6.0 billion decreased 4% sequentially. Geographically, North America revenue was flat sequentially and international revenue declined 5% sequentially. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The sequential revenue decline primarily reflects the typical seasonal activity decline in the Northern Hemisphere, with the decline in Europe/CIS/Africa more pronounced due to the depreciation of the ruble, as well as global supply chain constraints impacting Production Systems. In contrast, North America and Latin America revenue was essentially flat sequentially. By Division, Well Construction revenue was slightly higher than last quarter as strong drilling activity in North America, Latin America, and the Middle </p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">14</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">East more than offset the seasonal reductions in Europe/CIS/Africa and Asia. Reservoir Performance, Production Systems, and Digital &#38; Integration were sequentially lower due to seasonal reductions in activity and sales.</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Moving forward, the outlook for the rest of 2022&#8212;particularly in the second half&#8212;remains positive with both short- and long-cycle investments accelerating. Notably, a number of final investment decisions for long-cycle development projects have been approved, new contracts were awarded, offshore exploration drilling is resuming, and several customers have announced a significant step-up in their spending plans for this year and over the next few years. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Consequently, it is Schlumberger&#8217;s view that increased activity&#8212;both on land and offshore&#8212;higher technology adoption, and pricing momentum will drive simultaneous growth internationally and in North America. This will result in a sequential seasonal rebound in the second quarter followed by significant growth in the second half of the year, particularly in the international market.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">With this backdrop and despite the uncertainty linked to Russia, Schlumberger believes the current market dynamics should allow it to maintain its full-year ambitions of year-on-year revenue growth in the mid-teens. Schlumberger&#8217;s positive outlook extends further into 2023 and <span style="color:#000000;">beyond as </span>it anticipates successive years of market growth<span style="color:#000000;">. </span>As demand <span style="color:#000000;">continues to </span>strengthen and new investments are committed to diversify energy supply, the duration and scale of this upcycle may potentially prove higher than originally anticipated, absent a setback in the economic recovery.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Digital &#38; Integration</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Digital &#38; Integration revenue of $857 million decreased 4% sequentially due to seasonally lower sales of digital and exploration data licenses primarily in North America and Europe/CIS/Africa. This decline was partially offset by strong contribution from our APS projects in Ecuador with the resumption of production following the pipeline disruptions in the previous quarter.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Digital &#38; Integration pretax operating margin of 34% contracted 372 bps sequentially primarily due to the effects of lower sales of digital and exploration data licenses.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Reservoir Performance</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Reservoir Performance revenue of $1.2 billion decreased 6% sequentially due to seasonal activity reductions, primarily in the Northern Hemisphere as well as reduced intervention and stimulation activity in Latin America. Revenue was also impacted by the depreciation of the ruble. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Reservoir Performance pretax operating margin of 13% contracted 232 bps sequentially due to reduced profitability from seasonally lower evaluation and stimulation activity, primarily in the Northern Hemisphere. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Well Construction</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Well Construction revenue of $2.4 billion was slightly higher sequentially driven by strong drilling activity in North America, Latin America, and the Middle East that was largely offset by seasonal reductions in Europe/CIS/Africa and Asia as well as the effects of the depreciation of the ruble.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Well Construction pretax operating margin of 16% expanded 77 bps sequentially due to improved profitability in integrated drilling. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Production Systems</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Production Systems revenue of $1.6 billion declined 9% sequentially due to lower sales of well production systems across all areas and reduced revenue from subsea projects. Revenue was temporarily impacted by supply chain and logistics constraints resulting in lower-than-expected product deliveries. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Production Systems pretax operating margin of 7% declined 192 bps sequentially. The margin contraction was primarily due to reduced profitability in well production systems driven by the impact of global supply chain and logistics constraints.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">15</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-size:9pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%;line-height:120%;vertical-align:top">(4)</sup></span></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:9pt;">Charges and credits are described in detail in Note 2 to the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Financial Statements.</span></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">First quarter 2022 revenue of $6.0 billion increased 14% year-on-year. Year-on-year revenue growth was led by Well Construction and Reservoir Performance, both of which grew more than 20%&#8212;outperforming global rig count growth. Digital &#38; Integration revenue grew 11%, while Production Systems revenue increased 1%. In Digital &#38; Integration, growth was driven by strong digital sales, increased exploration data license sales, and higher revenue from APS projects. In contrast, Production Systems growth was temporarily hampered by ongoing supply chain and logistics constraints, resulting in lower-than-expected product deliveries. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On a geographical basis, revenue growth compared to the same quarter last year was broad-based, with international revenue increasing 10% and North America growing 32%. International growth was widespread across all areas, led by Latin America. Europe/CIS/Africa grew primarily from higher Production Systems sales in Turkey and increased exploration drilling in offshore Africa. Middle East &#38; Asia revenue increased due to higher drilling, stimulation, and intervention activity. In North America, growth was pervasive across drilling and completions activity, coupled with a strong contribution from the APS project in Canada.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Digital &#38; Integration</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">First quarter 2022 revenue increased 11% to $0.9 billion, with growth in all areas driven by strong digital sales, increased exploration data license sales, and higher revenue from APS projects.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Year-on-year, pretax operating margin expanded 201 bps to 34% with improvement across all areas due to increased profitability in digital, exploration data licenses, and APS projects.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Reservoir Performance</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">First quarter 2022 revenue increased 21% to $1.2 billion as double-digit growth was posted in evaluation, intervention, and stimulation services both on land and offshore, with more exploration-related activity during the quarter.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Pretax operating margin expanded 299 bps year-on-year to 13%, due to improved profitability in evaluation and intervention activity.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">16</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Well Construction</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">First quarter 2022 revenue of $2.4 billion increased 24% year-on-year. Double-digit growth was recorded in drilling fluids, measurements, and in integrated drilling activity both on land and offshore.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Pretax operating margin expanded 534 bps year-on-year to 16%, with profitability improving in integrated drilling, equipment sales, and measurements services.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Production Systems</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">First quarter revenue of $1.6 billion increased 1% year-on-year. Double-digit growth in North America and Europe &#38; Africa was driven by new projects in contrast to reductions in Middle East &#38; Asia and Latin America resulting from the end of projects and temporary supply chain constraints.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Pretax operating margin of 7% declined 159 bps year-on-year. The margin contraction was primarily due to reduced profitability in well production systems driven primarily by the impact of global supply chain and logistics constraints.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Interest and Other Income</span></p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The effective tax rate for the first quarter of 2022 was 18%, as compared to 19% for the same period of 2021.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Charges and Credits</span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On December&#160;31, 2020, Schlumberger contributed its onshore hydraulic fracturing business in the United States and Canada, including its pressure pumping, pumpdown perforating and Permian frac sand business to Liberty Energy Inc. (&#8220;Liberty&#8221;) in exchange for an equity interest in Liberty.&#160;During the first quarter of 2022, Schlumberger sold 7.2&#160;million of its shares of Liberty and received proceeds of $84 million.&#160;&#160;As a result of this transaction Schlumberger recognized a gain of $26 million.&#160;This gain is classified in <span style="font-style:italic;">Interest&#160;&#38; other income</span> in the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Statement of Income</span>.&#160;&#160;As of March 31, 2022, Schlumberger had a 27% equity interest in Liberty.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger did not record any charges or credits during the first quarter of 2021.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">There were no borrowings under the commercial paper programs at March 31, 2022.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On April 21, 2022, Schlumberger&#8217;s Board of Directors approved a 40% increase in the quarterly cash dividend from $0.125 per share of outstanding common stock to $0.175 per share, beginning with the dividend payable on July 14, 2022, to stockholders of record on June 1, 2022.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger maintains an allowance for doubtful accounts in order to record accounts receivable at their net realizable value.&#160; Judgment is involved in recording and making adjustments to this reserve.&#160; Allowances have been recorded for receivables believed to be uncollectible, including amounts for the resolution of potential credit and other collection issues such as disputed invoices.&#160; Adjustments to the allowance may be required in future periods depending on how such potential issues are resolved, or if the financial condition of Schlumberger&#8217;s customers were to deteriorate resulting in an impairment of their ability to make payments.&#160; As a large multinational company with a long history of operating in a cyclical industry, Schlumberger has extensive experience in working with its customers during difficult times to manage its accounts receivable.&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger generates revenue in more than 120 countries.&#160; As of March 31, 2022, only four of those countries individually accounted for greater than 5% of Schlumberger&#8217;s net receivable balance, of which only two (the United States and Mexico) accounted for greater than 10% of such receivables.&#160; </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Included in <span style="font-style:italic;">Receivables, less allowance for doubtful accounts</span> in the <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Balance Sheet</span> as of March 31, 2022 is approximately $0.6 billion of receivables relating to Mexico.&#160; Schlumberger&#8217;s receivables from its primary customer in Mexico are not in dispute and Schlumberger has not historically had any material write-offs due to uncollectible accounts receivable relating to this customer.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">This first-quarter 2022 Form 10-Q, as well as other statements we make, contains &#8220;forward-looking statements&#8221; within the meaning of the federal securities laws, which include any statements that are not historical facts. Such statements often contain words such as &#8220;expect,&#8221; &#8220;may,&#8221; &#8220;can,&#8221; &#8220;believe,&#8221; &#8220;predict,&#8221; &#8220;plan,&#8221; &#8220;potential,&#8221; &#8220;projected,&#8221; &#8220;projections,&#8221; &#8220;forecast,&#8221; &#8220;estimate,&#8221; &#8220;intend,&#8221; &#8220;anticipate,&#8221; &#8220;ambition,&#8221; &#8220;goal,&#8221; &#8220;target,&#8221; &#8220;think,&#8221; &#8220;should,&#8221; &#8220;could,&#8221; &#8220;would,&#8221; &#8220;will,&#8221; &#8220;see,&#8221; &#8220;likely,&#8221; and other similar words. Forward-looking statements address matters that are, to varying degrees, uncertain, such as statements about Schlumberger&#8217;s financial and performance targets and other forecasts or expectations regarding, or dependent on, its business outlook&#59; growth for Schlumberger as a whole and for each of its Divisions (and for specified business lines, geographic areas or technologies within each Division)&#59; oil and natural gas demand and production growth&#59; oil and natural gas prices&#59; forecasts or expectations regarding energy transition and global climate change&#59; improvements in operating procedures and technology&#59; capital expenditures by Schlumberger and the oil and gas industry&#59; the business strategies of Schlumberger, including digital and &#8220;fit for basin,&#8221; as well as the strategies of Schlumberger&#8217;s customers&#59; Schlumberger&#8217;s effective tax rate&#59; Schlumberger&#8217;s APS projects, joint ventures, and other alliances&#59; Schlumberger&#8217;s response to the COVID-19 pandemic and its preparedness for other widespread health emergencies&#59; the impact of the ongoing conflict in Ukraine on global energy supply&#59; access to raw materials&#59; future global economic and geopolitical conditions&#59; future liquidity&#59; and future results of operations, such as margin levels. These statements are subject to risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, changing global economic and geopolitical conditions&#59; changes in exploration and production spending by Schlumberger&#8217;s customers and changes in the level of oil and natural gas exploration and development&#59; the results of operations and financial condition of Schlumberger&#8217;s customers and suppliers&#59; Schlumberger&#8217;s inability to achieve its financial and performance targets and other forecasts and expectations&#59; Schlumberger&#8217;s inability to achieve net-zero carbon emissions goals or interim emissions reduction goals&#59; general economic, geopolitical and business conditions in key regions of the world&#59; the ongoing conflict in Ukraine&#59; foreign currency risk&#59; </p>

If one or more of these or other risks or uncertainties materialize (or the consequences of any such development changes), or should our underlying assumptions prove incorrect, actual results or outcomes may vary materially from those reflected in our forward-looking statements. Forward-looking and other statements in this Form 10-Q regarding our environmental, social and other sustainability plans and goals are not an indication that these statements are necessarily material to investors or required to be disclosed in our filings with the SEC. <p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="ITEM_3_QUANTITATIVE_QUALITATIVE_DISCLOSU"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;3. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">For quantitative and qualitative disclosures about market risk affecting Schlumberger, see Item&#160;7A, &#8220;Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures about Market Risk,&#8221; of the Schlumberger Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December&#160;31, 2021. Schlumberger&#8217;s exposure to market risk has not changed materially since December&#160;31, 2021.&#160;&#160;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_4_Controls_and_Procedures"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;4. Controls and Procedures. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger has carried out an evaluation under the supervision and with the participation of Schlumberger&#8217;s management, including the Chief Executive Officer (&#8220;CEO&#8221;) and the Chief Financial Officer (&#8220;CFO&#8221;), of the effectiveness of Schlumberger&#8217;s &#8220;disclosure controls and procedures&#8221; (as such term is defined in Rules 13a-15(e) and 15d-15(e) under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (the &#8220;Exchange Act&#8221;)) as of the end of the period covered by this report. Based on this evaluation, the CEO and the CFO have concluded that, as of the end of the period covered by this report, Schlumberger&#8217;s disclosure controls and procedures were effective to provide reasonable assurance that information required to be disclosed in the reports that Schlumberger files or submits under the Exchange Act is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the Securities and Exchange Commission&#8217;s rules and forms. Schlumberger&#8217;s disclosure controls and procedures include controls and procedures designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed in reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act is accumulated and communicated to its management, including the CEO and the CFO, as appropriate, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure. There was no change in Schlumberger&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting during the quarter to which this report relates that has materially affected, or is reasonably likely to materially affect, Schlumberger&#8217;s internal control over financial reporting.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">20</p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always" />
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">PART II. OTHER INFORMATION </span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:6pt;">&#160;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_1_Legal_Proceedings"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;1. Legal Proceedings. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The information with respect to this Item&#160;1 is set forth under Note 9&#8212;<span style="font-style:italic;">Contingencies,</span> in the accompanying <span style="font-style:italic;">Consolidated Financial Statements</span>. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_1A_Risk_Factors"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;1A. Risk Factors. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_2_Sales_of_Equity">As of the date of this filing, there have been no material changes from the risk factors disclosed in Part 1, Item 1A, of Schlumberger&#8217;s Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021.</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="ITEM_2_UNREGISTERED_SALES_EQUITY_SECURIT"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;2. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds. </span></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">None. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Issuer Repurchases of Equity Securities </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As of March 31, 2022, Schlumberger had repurchased $1.0 billion of Schlumberger common stock under its $10 billion share repurchase program. Schlumberger did not repurchase any of its common stock during the first quarter of 2022. </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_3_Defaults_Upon_Senior_Securities"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;3. Defaults Upon Senior Securities. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">None<span style="font-weight:bold;">. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:18pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_4_Mine_Safety_Disclosures"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;4. Mine Safety Disclosures. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our mining operations are subject to regulation by the federal Mine Safety and Health Administration under the Federal Mine Safety and Health Act of 1977. Information concerning mine safety violations or other regulatory matters required by section 1503(a) of the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act and Item 104 of Regulation S-K is included in Exhibit 95 to this report.&#160;&#160;&#160;&#160;<span style="color:#000000;">&#160;&#160; </span>&#160;&#160;<span style="color:#000000;"> </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;" id="Item_5_Other_Information"><span style="text-decoration:underline;">Item&#160;5. Other Information. </span></p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In 2013, Schlumberger completed the wind down of its service operations in Iran. Prior to this, certain non-US subsidiaries provided oilfield services to the National Iranian Oil Company and certain of its affiliates (&#8220;NIOC&#8221;).</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Schlumberger&#8217;s residual transactions or dealings with the government of Iran during the first quarter of 2022 consisted of payments of taxes and other typical governmental charges. Certain non-US subsidiaries of Schlumberger maintain depository accounts at the Dubai branch of Bank Saderat Iran (&#8220;Saderat&#8221;), and at Bank Tejarat (&#8220;Tejarat&#8221;) in Tehran and in Kish for the deposit by NIOC of amounts owed to non-US subsidiaries of Schlumberger for prior services rendered in Iran and for the maintenance of such amounts previously received. One non-US subsidiary also maintained an account at Tejarat for payment of local expenses such as taxes. Schlumberger anticipates that it will discontinue dealings with Saderat and Tejarat following the receipt of all amounts owed to Schlumberger for prior services rendered in Iran.</p>

<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;">Non-Disparagement</p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_9kMIH5YVt39A6BLhX36xhx0lLL72w9HOO9B"></a><a name="_9kMHG5YVt48869GRHy0poD1rvR"></a><a name="_9kMIH5YVt48869GRHy0poD1rvR"></a><a name="_9kMI1H6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMN5G6ZWu4AB79FP8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMN5G6ZWu4AB79GQ8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMIH5YVt39A6BLhX36xhx0lLL72w9HOO9B"></a>Subject to the provisions above regarding Protected Disclosures<a name="_9kMHG5YVt48869GRHy0poD1rvR"></a>, both the Company and I<a name="_9kMIH5YVt48869GRHy0poD1rvR"></a> agree to refrain from any criticisms or disparaging comments about each other or in any way relating to my employment or separation and the Company and I<a name="_9kMI1H6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a> specifically acknowledge that our willingness to enter into this Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMN5G6ZWu4AB79FP8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMN5G6ZWu4AB79GQ8wvjstvB"></a> is in anticipation of our fidelity to this commitment.&nbsp;&nbsp;The above is not intended to restrict me from seeking or engaging in other employment (subject to my noncompetition covenant contained in the Agreement) and, in that connection, from: </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_9kMN6H6ZWu4AB79FP8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMN6H6ZWu4AB79GQ8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMN6H6ZWu4AB79FP8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMN6H6ZWu4AB79GQ8wvjstvB"></a>(i) disclosing to prospective employers the restrictive covenants in the Agreement to which I am bound (including as to non-competition, non-solicitation and non-disparagement) or </p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:7.69%;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_9kMH06N7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a><a name="_9kMH06N7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a>(ii) making confidential disclosure to potential employers of such facts or opinions as I may elect to convey, nor is it intended to restrict the Company from conducting such confidential internal communications as may be necessary to manage this resignation in a businesslike way.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">17</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<td valign="top" style="width:3.85%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.69%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">IX.</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU17"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Enforceability</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_9kMI2I6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMI3J6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMI2I6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a>Should any of the provisions set forth in this Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMI3J6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a> be determined to be invalid by a court, agency or other tribunal of competent jurisdiction, it is agreed that such determination shall not affect the enforceability of other provisions of this Waiver and Release.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">
<table border="0" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="0"  style="border-collapse:collapse; width:100%;">

<td valign="top" style="width:3.85%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;">&nbsp;</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:7.69%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">X.</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:12pt;">Completeness and Revocation </p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_9kMI4K6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMJI5YVt39A68HR7vuirsuAkM0549txG"></a><a name="_9kMH7O6ZWu57779AK8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMH07O7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a><a name="_9kMPO5YVt4886AHRH3536tw1PXCGI"></a><a name="_9kMI5L6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMH8P6ZWu57779AK8wvjstvB"></a><a name="_9kMH08P7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a><a name="_9kMHzG6ZWu5997BISI4647ux2QYDHJ"></a><a name="_9kMI4K6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a>I acknowledge that this Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMJI5YVt39A68HR7vuirsuAkM0549txG"></a> and the other Agreement Materials<a name="_9kMH7O6ZWu57779AK8wvjstvB"></a> set forth the entire understanding and agreement<a name="_9kMH07O7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a> between me and the Company<a name="_9kMPO5YVt4886AHRH3536tw1PXCGI"></a> or any other member of the Corporate Group<a name="_9kMI5L6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a> concerning the subject matter of this Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMH8P6ZWu57779AK8wvjstvB"></a> and supersede any prior or contemporaneous oral and written agreements<a name="_9kMH08P7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a> or representations, if any, between me and the Company<a name="_9kMHzG6ZWu5997BISI4647ux2QYDHJ"></a> or any other member of the Corporate Group.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:justify;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_9kMI6M6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMI7N6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMH09Q7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a><a name="_9kMML5YVt39A6AGQHz40mjyvy739"></a><a name="_9kMI8O6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMI9P6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a><a name="_9kMI6M6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a>I understand that for a period of 7 calendar days following the date that I sign this Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMI7N6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a>, I may revoke my acceptance of the offer, provided that my written statement of revocation is received on or before that seventh day by the Vice President, Human Resources, of Schlumberger Limited &#8211; Houston, in which case the Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMH09Q7aXv5BC8BGRJ02rqF"></a> will not become effective.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the event I revoke my acceptance of this offer, the Company<a name="_9kMML5YVt39A6AGQHz40mjyvy739"></a> shall have no obligation to pay, or otherwise deliver to me, any part of the Consideration<a name="_9kMI8O6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;I understand that failure to revoke my acceptance of the offer within seven (7) calendar days from the date I sign this Waiver and Release<a name="_9kMI9P6ZWu5997EJkOh30xurvaWxyo38"></a> will result in this Waiver and Release being permanent and irrevocable.</p>
